history.summary: A modern Krishna temple at Senki View, Cona, Itanagar (address: 138 BN, Senki View, Cona, Itanagar 791111). The presiding deities are Radha and Krishna in the Gaudiya Vaishnavite tradition. No published founding date or patron history was found in available sources, and the festivals listed are the major Radha-Krishna observances reported for this shrine. No exact map POI match was found, so coordinates are approximate (Senki View locality).

name: Sri Sri Radha Krishna Mandir, Itanagar
town_description: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, set in the foothills of the Eastern Himalayas within the Itanagar Capital Complex. Named after the 14th-15th-century Ita Fort, whose brick ramparts still ring parts of the city, it is the state's administrative and commercial hub, home to the Jawaharlal Nehru Museum, Ganga Lake and the Donyi Polo Vidya Bhawan; its twin town Naharlagun lies about 10 km to the north.

travel.airport: Donyi Polo Airport (Hollongi), about 14-15 km south of Itanagar
travel.road: On NH-415; reachable by road from Naharlagun and from Guwahati (Assam)
